sites.name: Ba Chua Xu Temple, Sam Mountain
sites.event: Associated with the legend of the sacred Ba Chua Xu and the Ba Chua Xu Festival (National Intangible Cultural Heritage).

sites.name: Oc Eo - Ba The Special National Relic Site
sites.event: A famous archaeological site, proving the existence and prosperity of the ancient Funan Kingdom.

sites.name: Tuc Dup Hill
sites.event: A resilient revolutionary base during the anti-American resistance war, famous for its nickname 'The $2 Million Hill' due to the amount of bombs and ammunition dropped on it.

sites.name: President Ton Duc Thang Memorial Site
sites.event: The birthplace and childhood home of President Ton Duc Thang (Uncle Ton), a beloved leader of the Vietnamese nation.

place.commune: My Hoa Hung Commune (Ong Ho Island)

sites.name: Thoai Ngoc Hau Tomb (Son Lang)
sites.event: The resting place of the famous mandarin Thoai Ngoc Hau, who made great contributions to reclaiming the Southwestern region and digging the Vinh Te Canal.

sites.name: Ba Chuc Ossuary
sites.event: A historical relic marking the genocidal crimes of the Pol Pot regime during the Southwest border war (1978).

sites.name: Cam Mountain (Thien Cam Son)
sites.event: The highest mountain in the That Son (Seven Mountains) region, associated with many legends and a major spiritual tourism center.

sites.name: Bung Binh Thien (Heavenly Lake)
sites.event: The largest natural freshwater lake in the Southwestern region, famous for its peaceful beauty and the culture of the Cham people living along the lakeside.

place.commune: Nhon Hoi Commune, Quoc Thai Commune

sites.name: Ta Pa Lake
sites.event: Known as the 'Tuyet Tinh Coc' of the West with its characteristic turquoise water.

sites.name: Jamiul Azhar Mosque
sites.event: One of the oldest and most beautiful mosques, a cultural symbol of the Cham Islam community in An Giang.

sites.name: Nui Sap Tourist Area (Ong Thoai Lake)
sites.event: Associated with the excavation of the Thoai Ha Canal by the famous mandarin Thoai Ngoc Hau for irrigation and trade.
